adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, `discourse_expires_in 1.minute` is executed unconditionally at the end of the action, even when the `else` branch renders `'loading'` (`render 'loading'`). That means the loading response will get the same caching headers as the normal response. Given `loading.html.erb` triggers `document.location.reload()` after 30s, a cached loading response (e.g., max-age 60s) can be re-served on reload and delay showing the real topic even after it exists.
